# CleanMark Ultra™
> Universelle Wasserzeichen-Entfernung fuer Bilder, Videos und Audio

- [Watermark-Enzyklopaedie](docs/nlm/01-watermark-history-timeline.md): Alle 70+ Watermark-Typen von 1954–2026, historische Timeline, Detection + Removal
- [App-Feature-Set](docs/nlm/02-app-features.md): 10 Feature-Gruppen, 60+ Features, Prioritaeten, Format-Support
- [Pattern-System](patterns/watermarks.patterns): 40+ Detection-Patterns (Regex, Hash, Frequency, Neural, Metadata)
- [Technische Architektur](docs/nlm/04-technical-architecture.md): System-Diagramm, Tech-Stack, Plugin-Interface, Datenfluss
- [Prototyp-Roadmap](docs/nlm/05-prototype-roadmap.md): Sprint-Plan, Code-Skizzen, Dependencies, naechste Schritte
- [Domain-Glossar](CONTEXT.md): Begriffe, Taxonomie, Systemkonzepte
